generation.scope: For two transverse thick-color directions of type (2,2,1,1), all windows with full rank-one rectangles are classified for regularity. Forty-eight geometric components fall into five symmetry orbits; four have an excessive degree-four character. The remaining two-parameter surface is regular exactly off u=v, including zero parameters, by a partial Fourier transform, a Klein cocycle and a symmetric basepoint-free four-quadric model. All points have minimum period one, with opposite rank twelve on three curves and sixteen elsewhere.

open_mathematics: Complete the simultaneous sparse (2,2,1,1) supports in the transverse and parallel sectors, and determine all exceptional parallel-direction dense windows and unmarked parameter equivalences.
